2393-4279-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

277-1021-1315-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

4186-8166-8181.description:
Cast Proctor of Potential by paying {W}{U}.
When Proctor of Potential enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Proctor of Potential triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

465-4681-8095.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.

1325-3967-5170-6132.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

511-817-2557-4050-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-2557-4050-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

215-4927-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-4927-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2292-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2292-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cause Vhal to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.

2932-5220-6797-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2932-5220-6797-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2932-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1987-4423-5243-6893.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping King Macar, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

1977-4499-6753.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Tivit.
When Tivit enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
1977-4499-6753.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead vote to get Clue tokens.

2034-4871-6010--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the persist creature trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

765-1479-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-6662.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1445-2292-4871-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2292-4871-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1287-4365-4918-6320.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-4365-4918-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create two token copies of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3372-4885-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

997-2178-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
997-2178-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

104-475-4186-4321.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Cleric Class is at least level two.
104-475-4186-4321.description:

Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite Foods, you may sacrifice them to Peregrin Took's ability.

1789-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Dragon.
1789-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken Dragon, adding {C}{C}.
The Dragon dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return the Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Lathliss, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1308-4152-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Undercity Scrounger.
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.

Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
